'''Parviz Ansari''' (July 25, 1954 – July 27, 2025) was an [[Iranian Americans|Iranian-American]] [[physicist]] and academic administrator. He held several senior positions in higher education, including [[Provost (education)|Provost]] and Vice President for Academic Affairs at [[Westfield State University]],<ref>{{cite web |title=People In Business: Dr. Parviz Ansari of Westfield State University |website=masslive |date=March 9, 2017 |url=https://www.masslive.com/business-news/2017/03/people_in_business_dr_parviz_ansari_of_w.html |access-date=September 11, 2025}}</ref> [[Provost (education)|Provost]] and [[Vice-chancellor|Vice Chancellor]] for academic affairs at [[Southern Illinois University Edwardsville]], and Dean of the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences at [[Rowan University]].<ref name="SIUE"/>

== Early life and education ==
Parviz Ansari was born in [[Shiraz]], Iran, on July 25, 1954. He earned a B.S. in Physics from [[Pahlavi University]] (now [[Shiraz University]]) in 1976. He later moved to the United States with a full scholarship for graduate studies at [[Tufts University]], where he completed his M.S. (1978) and Ph.D. (1983) in Physics and Astronomy.<ref name="SIUE"/>

== Career ==
Ansari was a professor at [[Seton Hall University]] from 1983 to 2009. He chaired the Physics Department (1994–2005) and later became Associate Dean of the College of Arts and Sciences.<ref name="SIUE"/>

In 2009, he was appointed Dean of the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences at [[Rowan University]] and later became the Founding Dean of the School of Biomedical Sciences. Ansari launched new doctoral and graduate programs including:<ref name="Rowan">{{cite web |title=Ansari named Dean at Rowan |url=https://today.rowan.edu/news/2009/07/ansari-named-dean-las-rowan.html |access-date=2025-07-25}}</ref>

* Ph.D. in [[Clinical psychology|Clinical Psychology]]
* M.S. in [[Bioinformatics]]
* M.S. in Health Data Analytics

Ansari served as [[Provost (education)|Provost]] and [[Vice Chancellor]] for Academic Affairs at [[Southern Illinois University Edwardsville]] (SIUE). During his tenure, new degree programs were introduced in [[Mechatronics]], [[Pharmaceutical Sciences]], and [[Business Analytics]].<ref name="SIUE"/>

He also created the Division of [[International Affairs]] and improved faculty diversity through strategic hiring.<ref name="SIUE">{{cite web |title=SIUE Board Confirms Ansari |url=https://www.siue.edu/news/2014/05/SIUBoardConfirmsAnsariasSIUEProvost.shtml |access-date=2025-07-25}}</ref>

At [[Westfield State University]], Ansari served as Provost and Vice President for Academic Affairs.<ref name="Westfield">{{cite web |title=Dr. Parviz Ansari Bio |url=https://www.acao.org/parviz-ansari-bio |access-date=2025-07-25}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He married in 1979 and is survived by his wife, a son and daughter. His interests included astronomy, physics, and [[Persian poetry]].<ref name="tribute"/>

In February 2019, Ansari was diagnosed with [[glioblastoma multiforme]] (GBM), an aggressive form of [[brain cancer]]. Following intensive treatment and a period of remission, in October 2024 he was then diagnosed with small cell [[neuroendocrine carcinoma]] (SCNC), a rare and fast-progressing malignancy. He died on July 27, 2025 in [[Boston]], Massachusetts.<ref name="tribute">{{cite web |title=Parviz Ansari Obituary |website=Arlington, MA |date=July 27, 2025 |url=https://tributearchive.com/obituaries/43778005/parviz-ansari/arlington/massachusetts/keefe-funeral-homes |access-date=September 11, 2025}}</ref>

== Honors and affiliations ==
His honors and affiliations include:<ref name="iranian">{{cite web |last=Ansari |first=Fariborz |title=iranian.com: Iranian of the day |website=The Iranian |url=https://iranian.com/PhotoDay/2005/April/ansari.html |access-date=September 11, 2025}}</ref>

* [[American Council on Education]] (ACE) Fellow, 2005–2006
* Leadership New Jersey Fellow, 2008
* [[Phi Kappa Phi]] and [[Sigma Pi Sigma]] Honor Societies
* Service awards from [[Seton Hall University|Seton Hall]] and [[Rowan University|Rowan Universities]]
* Founding member of the New Jersey Big Data Alliance
* Board member, St. Louis Academy of Science, [[Council of Colleges of Arts and Sciences]] (CCAS)

== Research and publications ==
Ansari’s scientific research was in [[condensed matter physics]] and [[x-ray absorption spectroscopy]]. He conducted research at [[Cornell University]]'s CHESS Lab and [[Brookhaven National Laboratory]]. He published various peer-reviewed articles on topics such as [[superconductivity]] in rare-earth materials, thin film [[ferroelectrics]], and multilayer magnetic structures in journals such as:<ref name="SIUE"/>
* ''[[Physical Review B]]''
* ''[[Journal of Applied Physics]]''
* ''Materials Research Society Proceedings''
